projects.text: The movement is the watch’s mechanism: small parts that fit together so everything works. Projects are the same; what matters is how they fit inside.

experience.text: The dial and hands are what you read on a watch: time, in order. Experience is told the same way, chapter by chapter.

stack.text: To see what a watch is made of, you take it apart. Here are the loose pieces, grouped by the part of the watch they match.

evolution.text: The revisions of a watch are engraved on the case back. Here is the record of this website’s versions and what changed in each.

contact.text: The crown is how you wind a watch. It is also where you can write to me.
